claim: Salesforce's fiscal Q2 2026 gross profit topped $8.6 billion for the first time.
summary: Without browsing or filing access the precise GAAP gross profit for Salesforce fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ended July 31, 2025) and its full historical gross profit series cannot be verified from internal knowledge alone, so neither the >$8.6B value nor the 'first time' record claim can be established as supported or contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Salesforce's fiscal Q2 2026 gross profit was greater than $8.6 billion
sub_claims.note: No tool access to 10-Q/earnings release; exact gross profit figure for FY26 Q2 cannot be confirmed from memory alone.

sub_claims.text: Fiscal Q2 2026 was the first time Salesforce's gross profit exceeded $8.6 billion
sub_claims.note: Verifying 'first time above' requires complete historical gross profit series for all prior quarters, which is not available without tools.
